name: Ogata
source:
An always calm doctor.
He is a regular at your teahouse and will help you even after becoming a shadow warrior.
He seems to be the exclusive doctor of Hinata.

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/shinooku/chara/ogata.html]official website[/url]]
